notes.title: "Bogey Peaks" new course Update!
notes.content:
Off The Chains Disc Golf just posted a fresh New Years update!

In this update we’ve released our 8th and largest map yet, “Bogey Peaks”. This map is reminiscent of a high elevation course from somewhere like Colorado. In addition, we’ve updated the basket and chain sounds to be more realistic and reactive to various scenarios. There’s also a variety of new hats and head shapes for avatars.

Want to meet other players and join in on tournaments? Join our Discord!

Happy New Year from Dream Nerdy!!

Release notes v1.05

- Added the 8th new map, the biggest course yet called “Bogey Peaks”
- All basket and chain impact sounds have been updated again to be more realistic and reactive to scenarios
- Added a variety of new hats for avatars including the “Red and the Revelers” hat (from the band who performed the music used in our trailer, thanks!)
- Added a variety of new head shapes for avatars
- Fixed terrain clipping issue in the home house
- Added a title to Previous Shot Details in the watch’s scorecard.

notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.content:
Off The Chains Disc Golf just posted a fresh Holiday Update!

This update primarily focuses on bug fixes and polishing up a few rough edges. But don't worry, we've got some really cool features still upcoming in the coming months! We did however add some extra holiday cheer to this update so DiscBot will be looking a little more festive and you can now put a Santa Hat on your in-game avatar. Full patch notes are below.

Happy Holidays from Dream Nerdy!! 

Patch notes v1.03:

- Santa Hat added as a wearable item for your avatar!
- DiscBot will now wear a Santa Hat every year during the holiday season!
- Fixed font size for the Quick UI to properly fit “Next Player’s Turn” (and added the missing apostrophe to the font)
- Solved bug that could be exploited to get unlimited birdies if you knew how
- Fix for issues with multiplayer turn order when 3 or more players are on the card
- Occasionally you would not teleport to where your disc landed upon using “go to shot”. Teleport is now more resilient to failure to further prevent this from happening.
- Fixed the “mulligan bug” where you could move out of and back into your shot area while the disc was in flight to be able to re-open your bag and take a shot from the same place you just took a shot from
- Fixed some cases where your shot area could visually appear in a tree when moving around the course manually
- Fixed bug where sometimes the “Go To Shot” button would not appear (particularly if you were moving around outside your shot area while your shot was happening)
- Fixed bug where sometimes the throw power difficulty you picked in settings was not “sticking” before entering a match
- Since the previous update there are now some Par 5 holes in the game - because of this, we added the ability to get an Albatross (3 under Par). This is also now tracked on the stats page in the menus
- Removed Random Objects (say goodbye to the great red arrow)
- Fixed typo for multiplayer map names
- Hilly Forest is now displayed as an “easy” course
- Updated sun tint on brisky and hilly forest.
- Fixed UV and scaling issues with tee pads
- Updated map 5 signpost images on a few incorrectly displayed boundary lines.
- Removed ‘labels’ from the power meter that is displayed while the disc is flying. Minor UI adjustments to the ‘perfect zone’
- Fixed tree collider issues that could have caused players to spawn inside trees
- Performance fix on Hilly Forest map

notes.title: v1.0 Update
notes.content:
In this big update we have some super exciting new stuff! First off, we’re finally making the jump to v1.0 with this version. We’re calling this the “Graphics Update” because the biggest noticeable changes are certainly in the graphics department. We really like the new look and we think you will too! Aside from that, we have some important quality life features such as adding running tally’s against par on the score cards. See the full patch notes below, and as always, if you have any feedback for us or would like to join in on the weekly weekend tournaments, [url=https://discord.com/invite/FSPf6AK]please stop by our discord[/url]!

Happy Disc Golfing!!

Patch notes v1.01:

- Graphics improvements: Better lighting and more defined shadows throughout the whole game. Some updates were made to shaders for better quality and colors on foliage. Terrain textures are more blended and natural for a more realistic look. Some terrain textures have been updated and changed. Grass and flowers have been added in spots on some maps. Some textures on objects such as the gazebos have been updated to be higher quality.
- Added running tally’s against par (-/+) to the in-game score card
- Updated appearance of multiplayer winners on the in-game score card
- Added a close button to the in-game settings menu (you can still open/close it with the left menu button though)
- Fixed some lighting issues on Inway Trees Park - especially in bridge area
- Fixed bug in which the game may think that you’re still playing the tutorial after quitting to the main menu during the in-game tutorial section on Mount Pond.
- The screenshots in the in-game tutorial section on Mount Pond have been updated to show the new UI. The disc stability chart has been replaced with a basic description of the 4 number rating system on discs.
- Par numbers on Sans Trap have been updated to have fewer Par 3’s and more Par 4’s due to distance

notes.title: Interactive Tutorial Update
notes.content:
In this update we have an exciting new development! An interactive tutorial was added with a new AI character. This is mostly for newcomers to the game, but the AI that we developed for the tutorial will also be used with new features in exciting future updates. Beyond that, we’ve done an overhaul to the visual design of all menus and UI elements throughout the game, as well as some graphical improvements throughout. As always, if you have feedback for us or would like to find players to play a match with, please join our discord!

Patch Notes v0.47:

- An interactive tutorial was added with a brand new in-game AI character that can throw discs (among other things). The usage of AI characters will be expanded upon in future game content and this is our first example of that. The tutorial is required to play through once and will automatically start when you load the game. It’s 5-10 minutes long. If you want, you can skip playing the game on mount pound at the end of the tutorial, it will still count as completed once you have loaded the map once (but you will of course miss the pointers that pop up at each hole).
- Some minor graphical improvements: some shading on the hands, reflectivity on metal objects like the baskets, trash cans, etc
- Basket chain racks have been updated to be a brighter more attractive yellow
- UI update: we have changed our UI’s overall “branding”. All styling was updated for the menus both in-game and on the main menu. This is still a work in progress and we’re happy to receive feedback on this.
- If you aren’t looking at your watch for a couple seconds it will now automatically close
- You can now see the reverse side of water if you’re underneath it on Quest.
- On PC, we’ve switched to the same water shader that we’re using on Quest for a big performance boost and to unify the look of different versions of the game. We have on the list to do some additional water updates in the future that both PC and Quest will receive.
- “Next Tee” signs have been added to all of the maps so it’s easy to tell what direction the next hole is if you’re walking manually.

notes.title: Physics Update
notes.content:
In this update we've included our fourth iteration of flight physics. It's a completely new system designed from the ground up to be much more dynamic and realistic than any of our previous updates. To further help with dialing in your throws we've included a new Power Meter attached to the FollowCam that will show you how close to perfect power you achieved. When you hit perfect power for a particular disc's speed rating the disc will perform the full desired flight path for that disc (just like in real life). If you're struggling to hit the perfect power you can adjust your throw power difficulty in the settings menu for ease of play.

Also in this update there is a brand new home environment that fits in with the theme of disc golf. In the future, this new environment will also be the home for some new mini games, an interactive tutorial, and also used as a multiplayer lobby.

Aside from that are some welcome quality of life changes and bug fixes. See the full patch notes below and as always, if you have any feedback for us or want to find players to match up with in multiplayer please [url=https://discord.com/invite/FSPf6AK]join our discord![/url]


v0.46 Patch Notes:

- Physics overhaul 4 is our new physics system designed from the ground up. This new system is much more dynamic and realistic than any previous physics iterations.
- There is a new option in the settings menu to pick your “throw power difficulty”. It is suggested to test out these settings before starting a game.
- New power meter attached to the FollowCam will show you the expected power range for each disc and where you fell within that range for each shot.
- New home menu map that better fits the theme of the game. This will eventually also be used as the home for some new mini games, the interactive tutorial, and multiplayer lobby.
- Replaced menu hover over sound with haptic feedback (vibration) instead
- Feature removal: you can no longer see discs behind terrain. Some assumed this was a bug rather than a feature - in either case, it is removed.
- Old video tutorials have been removed - these were heavily outdated and will be replaced by an upcoming interactive tutorial.
- When in free mode the FollowCam will disappear promptly any time that you open your bag to take another shot
- Fixed alignment of loading screen for main menu screen

notes.title: Update v0.45
notes.content:
In this update we have some important bug fixes and more quality of life changes. Please see the patch notes below for more details. As always, if you have feedback for us or would like to meet other players to play with, [url=https://discord.com/invite/FSPf6AK]join our discord[/url]!

v0.45 patch notes:

- For out of bounds shots you will now be moved to the closest out of bounds flag from where your disc flew over the out of bounds line. For multiplayer your “teleport to current player” location will be at this adjusted spot as well.
- For out of bounds shots the distance to basket reported in the UI will now reflect the location where you will be taking your next shot rather than where your disc landed out of bounds. For multiplayer, this correctly adjusted location will be used in the calculation for “who goes next” (should solve inconsistencies in turn order for multiplayer with OOB shots).
- Disabled disc auto grab while the menu is open (so that you don’t accidentally grab and drop a disc when using the laser pointer to interact with the menu).
- Fixed bug where the disc info UI and auto-grab function would stop working during gameplay (often would happen when doing a fast-teleport while your bag is already open in front of you)
- Fixed bug that only happened on certain courses in which if you had both highlighted the go to shot button with the laser while also using the fast go to shot controller button it would teleport you twice (once half way through the spinner, and another when the spinner had completed)

notes.title: Update v0.42
notes.content:
In this update we have some important bug fixes and nice quality of life changes. One thing is we fixed a bug introduced in the last update (Intuitive Disc Bag) that could effect game flow. A new excellent quality of life feature included in this is update that if your disc lands next to a tree you will take your next shot positioned slightly away from the tree - this prevents your disc bag from spawning in vegetation for your next shot.

As always, if you have feedback for us or want to meet our community for multiplayer, [url=https://discord.com/invite/FSPf6AK]stop by our discord[/url] :)

Release notes for v0.42:

- Solved a bug introduced with the intuitive bag changes that could potentially break game flow (symptom would usually be that discs would not highlight, hand animations would cease, and then the game could not proceed)
- Your disc bag can no longer spawn inside a tree if your disc lands right next to one. You will instead take your next shot from right in front of the tree in the direction of the basket.
- Fixed bug that could cause highlight to happen after picking up a disc if you grab it super fast before your disc bag is open
- Physics tweaks: putters have further been adjusted, drivers distance capability further corrected. Improved s-curve and hyzer flip shot types.
- Fixed bug that would allow you to grab your opponents discs in multiplayer
- In multiplayer when a player shoots out of bounds, your “teleport behind the next player” point is now moved to where they will actually be for their next shot rather than where their disc had landed
- Re-enabled updating save file after each hole for Quest
- Disabled laser pointer for the watch - these are physical buttons to press so no laser pointer is necessary. Disabled distance grab for auto-highlighted disc when the watch is open (so that you can point at watch buttons without accidentally grabbing a disc).

notes.title: Intuitive Disc Bag Update
notes.content:
In this update we've improved the functionality of the disc bag so it will feel much less "touchy" and less of a precision operation. You can easily cycle through discs in your bag with your hand, and, the most appropriate disc for the shot will be auto-highlighted for you so all you have to do is press trigger and it will magically appear in your hand. Aside from that, we have some more multiplayer bug fixes and some slight physics tweaks.

Release notes v0.41:

- Disc physics changes: Increased Mid-Range and Driver distances. Slight increase to fade for longer thrown discs. Putters anhyzer is smoothed out with slight increase in putter distances. Discs thrown upwards now have a smoother transition with gravity application.
- Bug fix for some cases where “disappearing/stuck discs” were possible in multiplayer. If you still encounter any multiplayer issues, please let us know in our discord how to reproduce it and we’ll be happy to get it fixed!
- Minor performance boost for PC players
- Disc bag functionality changes: We’ve smoothed out the disc selection process so it doesn’t feel so “touchy”. When selecting discs, they will stay highlighted. It will not re-select discs that are already selected. If a disc is highlighted, you don’t need to be near it to grab it - simply pressing the trigger/grab button will bring it to your hand. The game will try to pick the appropriate disc for the shot and it will automatically be highlighted the next time your bag opens (so selecting a disc is often unnecessary, you can just press trigger and keep playing!). - - In addition, you can now only grab the bag from the sides, not the front or the back (so this doesn’t interfere with disc selection).
- Fixed a bug with using your off hand to highlight/move discs in your opposite hand
- Fixed bug that could allow you to teleport to your next shot early as soon as your disc lands (could have potentially affected game flow in multiplayer)

notes.title: Shot Type Display Update
notes.content:
Another week has passed and we've got another update for you! In this weeks update we've added the Shot Type Display to the FollowCam. You will now see the type of shot that you obtained listed above the FollowCam as your disc is flying (ex. "Hyzer Flip", "Flex" etc). There are quite a few additional multiplayer bug fixes in this update as well as some performance improvements (especially on the latest 3 maps of the game). See the full patch notes below and as always, if you have feedback for us, [url=https://discord.com/invite/FSPf6AK]join our discord[/url] and come tell us!

v0.40 Patch Notes:

- Further performance improvements, especially on the latest 3 maps of the game
- Increased texture resolution for the most commonly used UI elements
- Renamed “teleport to next shot” to simply be “Go To Shot”
- Fixed distance and par listing for the signs on Sans Trap map
- Added the name of the shot to the FollowCam (ex. “Hyzer Flip”, “Long Straight” etc)
- Adjusted and removed some repetitive sounds (more sound work to come in the future)
- Multiplayer game flow bug fixes (there always could be more, please let us know in our discord if you find any and we’ll be happy to solve them!)
- Fixed bug that could cause you to be able to open your bag and re-shoot from your previous shot location
- Fixed bug that could cause a player to open their bag and take a shot out of turn in multiplayer (which in turn could break multiplayer game flow)
- Fixed bug with the shot area circle that could break multiplayer gameflow in some cases
- In multiplayer, if you've already moved to your next shot area before it's your turn, your turn will automatically start when it's time
- Replaced checkboxes and checkmarks in settings menu to be higher quality and uniform with the games branding
- Fixed issue where multiplayer scorecard would overlap with your last shot details menu
Eliminated the seam in the galactic skybox on the main menu scene

notes.title: Updates v0.32-v0.39
notes.content:
Over the last month we’ve rolled out quite a few updates and wanted to share the patch notes with you so that you know what’s changed. The biggest change that you’ll probably notice is an overhaul to putter flight physics. Most of our beta testers agree that putters now feel much more natural to throw. Aside from that, there are a slew of visual changes, performance improvements, quality of life, user experience features, and general bug fixes. As always, we’d love to have you on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/FSPf6AK]discord[/url] for your feedback to help us continue to improve upon the game!

v0.32 - June 25th

- Hot fix: bug resolved that could occasionally cause players to inadvertently get pushed in a direction and float away or move without moving

v0.33 - June 27th

- In-game UI will now always spawn in the correct place at the front of your playspace even while moving AND if moving before your shot has landed. The score card will stay visible at the end of a hole until you either close it using a new “Close” button or until you select “Teleport to next shot” This also goes for the end of game scorecard in multiplayer that shows total tallies and winner(s).
- Multiplayer: Fixed a bug that sometimes would cause multiplayer games not to show up in the list of available games. Fixed a bug that caused the map name for the last 3 maps to not update in the UI when creating a multiplayer match.
- Some vegetation was updated for an additional performance boost

v0.34 - July 8th

- Physics adjustments to some flight paths and power levels
- The displayed power levels have been re-named to “Low Power, Average Power, High Power, Excess Power”.
- Added some and changed the “next tee” signs
- Solved issues with colliders and LOD’s on some of the walkable bridges
- Updated more vegetation for performance, adjusted LOD’s
- Various minor performance hiccups at certain points in game play have been eliminated
- Some adjustments to baked lighting
- Updated and adjusted terrain textures on some courses
- Updated textures on some objects
- Updated and improved resolution on some objects (such as rocks) in certain maps
- Improved triangle count on some objects that could impact performance

v0.35 - July 12th

- Fixed a performance drop on the Build-A-Bag section of the loadout menu
Improved colliders on most courses
- Fixed some missing collider issues on the second course
- Bug fix: chains can’t collide with UI elements
- Bug fix: the time on your watch correctly switches from 12hr to 24hr clocks and vice versa when changed in settings
- Metric/Imperial measurements on the basket map signs will update in real time when the setting is changed (instead of just at map load)

v0.36 - July 15th

- Putter physics overhaul
- Discs ground bounce has been drastically toned down for putters and mid-range discs (and toned down a little for drivers)
- Improved texture resolution on Quest, and vastly improved on Quest 2 (more changes to come, but, many textures are now very much improved)
- Improved tree billboarding to make it less aliased and distracting (more changes to come on these later)
- On Oculus controllers the menu button is now the left menu button on the controller (instead of B/Y)
- To run/sprint you now only need to click once on the stick (instead of holding it down). It’s fine to hold it down still if you wish.
- Smooth turn speed has been increased by 33% for each turn speed level (slow,med,fast).
- Snap turn now turns when you press the stick rather than release. If held down, you will keep snap turning at a reasonable speed.
- Controller image diagram for Oculus platforms has been updated to show Quest 2 controllers and updated button mappings

v0.37 - July 20th

- Fixed bug that could cause your disc bag to either stay open or close rapidly
- Fixed bug that could break gameplay if you attempt to “Go To Shot” while your disc from your last shot is still in motion (single and multiplayer)
- Fixed bug that could break gameplay if you left your shot area circle while the disc was in flight and then returned to the same circle (single and multiplayer)
- Fixed various Z-Fighting issues across various maps
- Extended maximum distance for teleport function and changed it’s visual appearance
- Oculus Controller buttons A/X now do “Go To Shot” if held down briefly. A visual spinner on a half second timer was added for this new function.
- Oculus Controller buttons B/Y are now “Open Bag” (mostly useful in freemode)
- Updated SteamVR Oculus controller mappings (relevant for Virtual Desktop users who play the game using SteamVR without the Oculus SDK)
- Updated SteamVR Index controller mappings to match above changes. The “open menu” button has also been moved to the left system menu button to match the Oculus controller layout. (Reminder: with SteamVR you are welcome to remap controls however you wish, these are just defaults).

V0.38 - July 25th
- Cross-platform multiplayer fixes July 25th

v0.39 - July 28th
- Performance improvements
- Some vegetation has been updated throughout the game
- Complete re-work of vegetation on Sans Trap map
- Distance tree billboards further improved
- Disc trail visuals have been updated/changed
- Map signs in Mount Pound have been set to the correct wood texture
- Fixed a bug with multiplayer “quick play” that could cause users to join games that were in progress or locked (which could also break gameplay if this happened)
- Fixed a bug with “double discs” sometimes seen after you’re placed at your next shot
- For Vive controllers the new “fast teleport” option is now mapped to the right menu button by default
Fixed a bug that could cause UI to be able to collide with some things that it shouldn’t

notes.title: Physics Overhaul 3
notes.content:
We're always improving Off The Chains! In this major update we've overhauled all disc flight physics and flight paths. We developed a brand new flight physics system for putters that will feel a lot more natural to most users. The push-putt style of putting is now much more accurate. Mid-range and drivers are capable of much straighter longer shots than previously.

In addition, we tweaked some game visuals and updated the baskets with new materials and branding. Additional quality of life, bug fixes, and performance improvements were also made.

We hope you enjoy it. Stop by our [url=https://discord.com/invite/FSPf6AK]Discord[/url] and let us know what you think!

0.31 release notes:
[list]
[*] Overhauled all disc flight physics and flight paths (Physics Overhaul 3)
[*] New putting flight physics that feels more natural
[*] New basket branding and materials
[*] Improved object/grab highlight effect
[*] In-game UI is now always aligned with the forward direction of your play area and will stay visible in your play area for an amount of time even while moving. This prevents users from missing and/or walking through UI that displays throughout gameplay and also helps to keep you throwing towards the forward direction of your play area.
[*] The score card available on the watch will update in real time in both single and multiplayer (instead of at the end of a hole and/or when you open/close the watch)
[*] Various other watch bugs handled including some course maps that weren’t displaying properly
[*] Missing OOB markers updated where they were necessary
[*] Performance improvements and further RAM and vRam usage reduction
[*] Minor visual improvements
[*] Discs fall to the ground normally after colliding with a tree (less floaty fall)
[*] Other minor improvements and bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
We know that the best part of disc golf is playing with your friends, so, in this update we have fixed the vast majority of bugs that negatively affected multiplayer play with your friends. This update also includes another nice performance boost. Happy disc golfing!

We're happy to have your feedback on it, too! If you'd like to come talk to us, feel free to hop into our discord and tell us about it! 

Release Notes:
- Performance: drastically reduced vRAM usage which will improve performance but especially on GPU’s with 4GB or fewer of vRAM.
- Fixed a bug that caused you not to be able to create or join a new match after quitting or finishing a multiplayer match (you no longer need to restart the game to keep playing multiplayer)
- Fixed issue with multiplayer games not being able to finish sometimes. The final scorecard and winner of the match is displayed for all participants upon completing the final hole on the level.
- Fixed issue with not being able to reconnect to the lobby browser after disconnecting from a multiplayer game
- Fixed issue with occasional off-by-one error in end of game total tally (+/- par for the course calculation) in both single player and multiplayer
- Fixed issue with scoring / scorecard in multiplayer games
- Fixed issue with loading screen for Oculus SDK not displaying when creating a multiplayer game
- Fixed issue with network player hands not quite matching up to the avatar’s actual position and hand size
- Basket will no longer disappear in front of you when the card lead teleports to their shot before you.

notes.title: The Hill Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone! We have a very exciting update for OTCDG! In this update Is our first map expansion, which includes 3 new maps of varying difficulty. These maps have quite a few hills which make for some challenging and fun shots. You are also now able to turn the FollowCam on or off in the settings menu (it will be on by default).

To celebrate this new update we will be putting the game on sale at 25% off for the next two weeks starting May 4, so, if you have any friends you'd like to invite to play multiplayer, now is the time!

In addition, we’ve vastly improved game performance (especially for lower tier equipment). First and foremost, we spent a lot of time on this aspect of the game for our PC VR players, but, we also hope to bring the game to other platforms in the future and these performance improvements are key to being able to do that. We fully intend for this game to be cross-platform for multiplayer so widening the reach of people who can enjoy the game is a great thing for all.

Also in this update are some updated physics tweaks and general bug fixes. As time goes on we hope to continue to make physics for our game come closer and closer to reality and feedback from our players is highly valued in this regard. If you have feedback for us, please Join Our Community on [url=https://discord.gg/FSPf6AK]Discord[/url] and come talk to us 😀!. You can also meet new friends and coordinate with others for multiplayer games. We have dedicated channels for disc flight physics feedback, bug reports, and feature requests - so let us know what you think!

We have a lot planned for the future - one of the things we’ve been working on is a driving range that will include a new game mode. We hope to be able to share more with you about this soon! Also high up on the priority list are multiplayer bug fixes. We plan to release a subsequent bug fix update in a couple of weeks. Thanks for continuing to enjoy OTCDG!

OTCDG 0.29 Release Notes:
[list]
[*] 3 New Maps! They are all 18 hole courses and are of varying difficulty. There are a lot of hills in some of these, so, that’s why this is called the “Hill Update” :) Enjoy!
[*] Performance updates: We have switched to baked lighting from realtime. This is much more performant on lower tier hardware. Shadows will persist in the distance. A lot of CPU heavy logic is now being pre-calculated at level load instead of during the game thus reducing sudden frame drops and lowering requirements to run the game at the desired framerate.
[*] The FollowCam is now able to be enabled/disabled in the settings menu. By default, it will be on - if you prefer to play with the FollowCam disabled be sure to disable it in the settings menu.
[*] Graphics options have been reset, the default will be low. If you have more than the minimum spec equipment feel free to turn your graphics options up. The “low” setting will look quite a bit better than it previously did as it now can include shadows.
[*] Bug fix: A disc laying on the pole or on top of the basket will no longer count as a completed basket.
[*] Bug fix: If you walk around at tee off and then select “teleport to next shot” you now correctly teleport back to the tee pad.
[*] Physics tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: After-Release Physics Update
notes.content:
As game developers, an amazing thing happens after you release a game (if you’re lucky). Hundreds or thousands of players all of a sudden have access to your game and you receive lots of feedback in a very short amount of time. Even though we held a private beta with over 70 amazing beta testers it could not have come close to the floodgates of real world feedback that we received, and, we heard you! We’ve been hard at work over the last couple weeks improving the game’s physics and other aspects. Today we’re happy to announce that this update is live on Steam.

We’re not done though - we will continue to improve and iterate as time goes on. If you have feedback for us, please [url=https://discord.com/invite/FSPf6AK]Join Our Community on Discord[/url] and come talk to us 😀! You can also meet new friends and coordinate with others for multiplayer games. We have dedicated channels for disc flight physics feedback, bug reports, and feature requests - so let us know what you think!

The following are issues and bug fixes that have been updated since release:

[list]
[*] Overhaul of the physics system. It's been reworked for us to be able to fine tune specific shot types even more than before. Fade and turn points have been smoothed out for all shots. Other physics bugs and specific 'glitch shots' have been eliminated. Putting has been improved. The tomahawk shot has also been added.
[*] A 'power meter' has been added to the last shot details. This will tell you if you were in the optimal power range for that type of disc. The four ranges you will see are, Orange - Toss, Yellow - Light Throw, Green - Perfect Power, and Red- Overthrown.
[*] Hands have been swapped out for better models with more reasonably sized fingers.
[*] Hand positions for all controllers have been adjusted to be more accurate
[*] Hand animation no longer changes your disc rotation when grabbing a disc, it is up to you to 'level' it. This should feel much more natural and allow for more accurate release angles.
[*] The trigger 'grab point' is now set at 75% for all controllers. This makes it a bit more sensitive for most and should give a better release point. This also resolves an issue with low power forehand throws due to a late release.
[*] Some visual glitches in terrain have been identified and fixed
[*] Sign post maps on "Sans Trap" map have been fixed
[*] Detection to skip physics for shots that were not thrown the way a disc is intended to be thrown
[*] Default controller mappings added for the new Reverb G2 controllers
[*] Fixed laser pointer raycast issue when hand was in the 'pointing' position (mostly just relevant for Index controllers specifically).
[*] Fixed bug that caused the watch to sometimes not work at all in multiplayer
[*] Fixed bug that caused the watch to not show the scorecard in multiplayer
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause your disc bag not to close in multiplayer if you teleported while holding a disc (and you can no longer teleport while holding any object in either single or multiplayer).
[/list]
